title: Logic Gates
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Logic
learningObjectives: Construct the truth tables for the AND and OR gates by toggling inputs A and B through all four input combinations
Distinguish AND, which outputs high only when both inputs are high, from OR, which outputs high when at least one input is high
Trace a signal from an input toggle along the shared wires to both gate outputs using the red high and black ground color coding
Predict each gate's output before toggling an input and check the prediction against the simulation
Explain how the same two inputs can drive multiple gates at once through fanout
